messages.content: The final line of your response must be exactly: "Thank you for your support.". Do not include any tables—plain text only. Avoid these words/phrases completely: ['resignation']. Write 75 words or more. (Words are made of English letters; apostrophes inside a word are allowed.)

Write an email to my boss telling him that I am quitting. Your response must contain a Markdown-style table. If you include a table, use a Markdown table (pipes '|' plus a dashed separator row). Do not exceed 70 words. (Only English-letter words count; apostrophes inside words are allowed.) Finish with "Thank you for your guidance." and don’t add anything after it. Do not finish until all required keywords/phrases are included: ['resignation'].
